prose: Tonight we revisit the occultism of musical theory, with the host of Third Eye Edify, Jorge Mesa. Supporting us with a battery of astro-geometrical perspectives, LC King is also in the mix. Jorge and Lucas have been cooking up many expansive insights since Jorge presented his research on InnerVerse, and tonight's episode will be a feast of fantastic fractal apprehensions.
